changes.newValue: Added _MINERAL_COLOR_HINTS dict to SidescrollMining.gd. Contract order tracker now appends color name in parens: 'Iron (orange): 0/50 kg'.

snapshot.title: UX: Add ore colour legend to mining minigame
snapshot.description: Players cannot tell which colour ore on the mining map corresponds to the ore they need to mine. A visible colour key or legend is needed in the mining UI so players know what to aim for.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Mining UI shows a colour swatch next to each ore name in the order panel
Ore colours in the terrain match the swatches shown in the legend
Legend is visible at all times during mining (not hidden behind other UI)

snapshot.implementationNotes: Added _MINERAL_COLOR_HINTS dict to SidescrollMining.gd. Contract order tracker now appends color name in parens: 'Iron (orange): 0/50 kg'.
